stance: Consumer sentiment is weak and flat: 48.0 in October after 48.1 in September, still near the May 2026 low of 44.8. Inflation expectations edged up (1y 4.7%, 5y 3.5%), a minor hawkish signal for the Fed, not yet a de-anchoring. Soft sentiment tends to foreshadow softer retail spending, but the two often decouple, so we wait for hard spending data. German Ifo 90.2 in October (unconfirmed, single source) is a modest EUR offset. Stance: cautious, bearish lean on consumer, low conviction. A rebound above 52, firm retail sales, or 5y expectations above 3.5% would change the view.
